command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-04. THE COMPATIBILITY PROOF, and the owner's precondition for superseding
# anything: a native Windows Ollama pointed at the EXISTING model store must list the same models and
# answer the same API contract before the container definition is retired.
#
# It runs on 127.0.0.1:11435, deliberately NOT the canonical 11434. Claiming the canonical port
# before the proof passes would make the proof and the supersession the same act, which is exactly
# the ordering the owner decision forbids.
#
# It also records the store byte-for-byte before and after. "The models are still there" is a claim
# this lane will have to make later, and a claim about preservation that was never measured is not
# evidence. If native Ollama rewrites or migrates the store on first contact, this is where it shows.

$ollama = 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\dist\ollama.exe'
$store = 'D:\HermesData\ollama'
$models = "$store\models"
$P40 = 'GPU-4f7d4396-9304-d12f-7e9b-7f04d1236fc2'
$RTX = 'GPU-6d9ae165-7272-a38c-06b1-7276869e980f'
$smi = 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe'
$work = 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\_install'

function Store-Fingerprint($label) {
    $b = Get-ChildItem "$models\blobs" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Sum Length
    $m = Get-ChildItem "$models\manifests" -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $mh = ($m | Sort-Object FullName | ForEach-Object { (Get-FileHash $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash }) -join ''
    $agg = if ($mh) { (Get-FileHash -InputStream ([IO.MemoryStream]::new([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($mh))) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower() } else { 'NONE' }
    Write-Output "STORE_$label blobs=$($b.Count) bytes=$($b.Sum) manifests=$($m.Count) manifest_set_sha256=$agg"
}

Write-Output '--- PACKAGE-INTEGRITY ---'
$want = (Get-Content "$work\checksums.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_ -match 'ollama-windows-amd64\.zip' })
Write-Output "published_line=$want"
Write-Output "downloaded_sha256=$(Get-Content "$work\downloaded.sha256" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)"
$pub = ($want -split '\s+')[0]
$got = (Get-Content "$work\downloaded.sha256" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Trim()
Write-Output "CHECKSUM_MATCH=$($pub -eq $got)"
Write-Output "version=$(& $ollama --version 2>&1)"
Write-Output '--- RUNNERS-SHIPPED ---'
# A Tesla P40 is Pascal, compute capability 6.1. CUDA 13 dropped Pascal; CUDA 12 keeps it. Which
# runner directories this package ships decides whether the owner's decision is even reachable, so
# list them rather than assume.
Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\dist\lib\ollama' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Mode | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 80
Write-Output "driver_version=$(& $smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader -i 0)"

Store-Fingerprint 'BEFORE'

Write-Output '--- GPU-BEFORE ---'
& $smi --query-gpu=uuid,name,driver_model.current,memory.used,power.limit,temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader

Write-Output '--- START-SERVE-11435 ---'
$env:OLLAMA_HOST = '127.0.0.1:11435'
$env:OLLAMA_MODELS = $models
$env:CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES = $P40
$out = "$work\compat-serve.out.log"; $err = "$work\compat-serve.err.log"
Remove-Item $out, $err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$p = Start-Process -FilePath $ollama -ArgumentList 'serve' -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err
Write-Output "serve_pid=$($p.Id)"

$ready = $false
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 40; $i++) {
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 750
    try {
        $v = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/api/version' -TimeoutSec 5
        Write-Output "READY after $([math]::Round($i * 0.75, 1))s api_version=$($v.version)"
        $ready = $true; break
    } catch { }
}
Write-Output "ready=$ready"

if ($ready) {
    Write-Output '--- API-TAGS ---'
    $tags = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 30
    Write-Output "model_count=$($tags.models.Count)"
    $tags.models | Sort-Object name | ForEach-Object { "model=$($_.name) size=$($_.size) digest=$($_.digest.Substring(0,16)) family=$($_.details.family) params=$($_.details.parameter_size) quant=$($_.details.quantization_level) modified=$($_.modified_at)" }

    Write-Output '--- API-SHOW ---'
    try {
        $sh = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/api/show' -Method Post -Body (@{ model = 'llama3.2:3b' } | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 30
        Write-Output "show_llama32_family=$($sh.details.family) format=$($sh.details.format) quant=$($sh.details.quantization_level)"
    } catch { Write-Output "show_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }

    Write-Output '--- API-OPENAI-COMPAT ---'
    # The HERMES inference proxy talked OpenAI /v1/models. Preserving "the same API contract" means
    # that surface too, not just the native one.
    try {
        $oa = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1/models' -TimeoutSec 30
        Write-Output "v1_models_count=$($oa.data.Count) ids=$(($oa.data.id | Sort-Object) -join ',')"
    } catch { Write-Output "v1_models_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }

    Write-Output '--- LOAD-ON-P40 ---'
    $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    try {
        $body = @{ model = 'llama3.2:3b'; prompt = 'Reply with exactly: commissioned'; stream = $false; options = @{ num_predict = 16; temperature = 0 } } | ConvertTo-Json
        $g = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/api/generate' -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 300
        $sw.Stop()
        Write-Output "generate_ok wall_ms=$($sw.ElapsedMilliseconds)"
        Write-Output "response=$($g.response.Trim())"
        Write-Output "eval_count=$($g.eval_count) eval_duration_ns=$($g.eval_duration) prompt_eval_count=$($g.prompt_eval_count) prompt_eval_duration_ns=$($g.prompt_eval_duration) total_duration_ns=$($g.total_duration) load_duration_ns=$($g.load_duration)"
        if ($g.eval_duration -gt 0) { Write-Output "decode_tok_per_s=$([math]::Round($g.eval_count / ($g.eval_duration / 1e9), 2))" }
    } catch { $sw.Stop(); Write-Output "generate_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }

    Write-Output '--- WHERE-DID-IT-LOAD ---'
    & $smi --query-gpu=uuid,name,memory.used,utilization.gpu,power.draw,temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader
    Write-Output '--- COMPUTE-APPS ---'
    & $smi --query-compute-apps=gpu_uuid,pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv,noheader
    Write-Output "COMPUTE_APPS_RC=$LASTEXITCODE"
    Write-Output '--- API-PS ---'
    try {
        $ps = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/api/ps' -TimeoutSec 20
        $ps.models | ForEach-Object { "loaded=$($_.name) size=$($_.size) size_vram=$($_.size_vram) until=$($_.expires_at)" }
        if (-not $ps.models) { Write-Output 'API_PS_EMPTY' }
    } catch { Write-Output "ps_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
}

Write-Output '--- STOP-SERVE ---'
try { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output 'stopped=true' } catch { Write-Output "stop_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
Get-Process -Name 'ollama*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "STILL_RUNNING pid=$($_.Id) name=$($_.ProcessName)" }
Write-Output "listener_11435_after=$([bool](Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 11435 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue))"

Store-Fingerprint 'AFTER'

Write-Output '--- SERVE-LOG-GPU-LINES ---'
Get-Content $err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-String -Pattern 'gpu|cuda|library|inference compute|memory|runner|error|level=WARN|level=ERROR' | Select-Object -First 60 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }
Write-Output '--- SERVE-LOG-TAIL ---'
Get-Content $err -Tail 30 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output '--- SERVE-STDOUT-TAIL ---'
Get-Content $out -Tail 10 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
